0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-1, 4th in the Pacific and 1 game back, 14th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 6th in the West), with Sacramento having dropped its only game on the road and Memphis holding a one-game winning streak. The Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Grizzlies are missing Cedric Coward (wrist, sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3 and last beat Memphis 123-114 on February 23, 2026, in Memphis.
